t: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德一世成为奥斯曼帝国和伊斯兰教的卡利夫的苏丹.
te: Abdul Hamid I becomes Sultan of the Ottoman Empire and Caliph of Islam.
dz: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德一世成为奥斯曼帝国和伊斯兰教的卡利夫的苏丹.
de: Abdul Hamid I becomes Sultan of the Ottoman Empire and Caliph of Islam.

t: 大不列颠王国下令马萨诸塞州波士顿港根据"波士顿港口法案"关闭.
te: The Kingdom of Great Britain orders the port of Boston, Massachusetts closed pursuant to the Boston Port Act.
dz: 美国革命:大不列颠王国下令马萨诸塞州波士顿港根据"波士顿港口法案"关闭.
de: American Revolution: The Kingdom of Great Britain orders the port of Boston, Massachusetts closed pursuant to the Boston Port Act.

t: 路易十六和玛丽·安托瓦内特成为法国国王和王后。
te: Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette become King and Queen of France.
dz: 路易十六和玛丽·安托瓦内特成为法国国王和王后。
de: Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette become King and Queen of France.

t: 1774年的"入住法"已经颁布,允许殖民地美洲的总督在没有适当住所的情况下将英国士兵安置在无人…
te: The Quartering Act of 1774 is enacted, allowing a governor in colonial America to house British soldiers in uninhabited…
dz: 不可容忍法案:1774年的"入住法"已经颁布,允许殖民地美洲的总督在没有适当住所的情况下将英国士兵安置在无人居住的房屋,出屋,谷仓等建筑物中.
de: Intolerable Acts: The Quartering Act of 1774 is enacted, allowing a governor in colonial America to house British soldiers in uninhabited houses, outhouses, barns, or other buildings if suitable quarters are not provided.

t: 罗德岛州成为英国北美殖民地中第一个禁止进口奴隶的殖民地。
te: Rhode Island becomes the first of Britain's North American colonies to ban the importation of slaves.
dz: 罗德岛州成为英国北美殖民地中第一个禁止进口奴隶的殖民地。
de: Rhode Island becomes the first of Britain's North American colonies to ban the importation of slaves.

t: 英国人通过了"魁北克法案",为英属北美的魁北克殖民地规定了治理规则.
te: The British pass the Quebec Act, setting out rules of governance for the colony of Quebec in British North America.
dz: 英国人通过了"魁北克法案",为英属北美的魁北克殖民地规定了治理规则.
de: The British pass the Quebec Act, setting out rules of governance for the colony of Quebec in British North America.

t: 橙城决议(Orangetown Resolutions)被纽约省通过,这是反对英国议会强制法案…
te: Orangetown Resolutions are adopted in the Province of New York, one of many protests against the British Parliament's C…
dz: 橙城决议(Orangetown Resolutions)被纽约省通过,这是反对英国议会强制法案的多起抗议之一.
de: Orangetown Resolutions are adopted in the Province of New York, one of many protests against the British Parliament's Coercive Acts.

t: 俄土战争（1768–74）：俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国签订《库楚克开纳吉条约》，结束战争。这是奥斯曼统…
te: Russo-Turkish War (1768–74): Russia and the Ottoman Empire sign the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca ending the war. It is the …
dz: 俄土战争（1768–74）：俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国签订《库楚克开纳吉条约》，结束战争。这是奥斯曼统治者首次割让主要居民为穆斯林的领土，也是该帝国首次确立世俗权力与宗教权威的分离。
de: Russo-Turkish War (1768–74): Russia and the Ottoman Empire sign the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca ending the war. It is the first time that an Ottoman ruler surrendered territory largely populated by Muslims and the first time that a separation of secular and spiritual authority in the Ottoman Empire was established.

t: 英国科学家约瑟夫·普里斯特利发现了氧气气体,证实了德意志-瑞典化学家卡尔·威廉·舍勒先前发现这…
te: British scientist Joseph Priestley discovers oxygen gas, corroborating the prior discovery of this element by German-Sw…
dz: 英国科学家约瑟夫·普里斯特利发现了氧气气体,证实了德意志-瑞典化学家卡尔·威廉·舍勒先前发现这一元素.
de: British scientist Joseph Priestley discovers oxygen gas, corroborating the prior discovery of this element by German-Swedish chemist Carl Wilhelm Scheele.

t: 马萨诸塞湾殖民者在无血的"粉末警报"中崛起.
te: Massachusetts Bay colonists rise up in the bloodless Powder Alarm.
dz: 马萨诸塞湾殖民者在无血的"粉末警报"中崛起.
de: Massachusetts Bay colonists rise up in the bloodless Powder Alarm.

t: 在詹姆斯·库克船长第二次出海期间,新喀里多尼亚是欧洲人首先看到的.
te: New Caledonia is first sighted by Europeans, during the second voyage of Captain James Cook.
dz: 在詹姆斯·库克船长第二次出海期间,新喀里多尼亚是欧洲人首先看到的.
de: New Caledonia is first sighted by Europeans, during the second voyage of Captain James Cook.

t: 第一次大陆大会在费城召开.
te: First Continental Congress assembles in Philadelphia.
dz: 第一次大陆大会在费城召开.
de: First Continental Congress assembles in Philadelphia.

t: 第一次大陆大会谴责了英国议会的"不可容忍法案",要求英国让步.
te: The First Continental Congress denounces the British Parliament's Intolerable Acts and demands British concessions.
dz: 美国革命:第一次大陆大会谴责了英国议会的"不可容忍法案",要求英国让步.
de: American Revolution: The First Continental Congress denounces the British Parliament's Intolerable Acts and demands British concessions.

t: 大陆协会是针对英属岛屿和英属西印度群岛的非消费和不进口协议,由第一届大陆大会通过.
te: The Continental Association, a nonconsumption and nonimportation agreement against the British Isles and the British We…
dz: 美国革命:大陆协会是针对英属岛屿和英属西印度群岛的非消费和不进口协议,由第一届大陆大会通过.
de: American Revolution: The Continental Association, a nonconsumption and nonimportation agreement against the British Isles and the British West Indies, is adopted by the First Continental Congress.

t: 第一次大陆大会在费城休会.
te: The First Continental Congress adjourns in Philadelphia.
dz: 美国革命:第一次大陆大会在费城休会.
de: American Revolution: The First Continental Congress adjourns in Philadelphia.
